heroHeadline: Trump Calls Iran War 'Small Potatoes' as CENTCOM Sinks Tankers; Administration Drafts Stay-at-Home Parent Childcare Subsidy
heroSubtitle: President Trump, at his Bedminster club Saturday, September 5, 2026 (Day 594), dismissed the six-month Iran war as 'small potatoes' and said the US has 'essentially taken over Iran,' the same day CENTCOM sank Iranian oil tankers including the M/T Kylo in the Gulf of Oman in retaliation for IRGC ballistic-missile strikes on two US Navy vessels. Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf responded Sunday, September 6 (Day 595) that 'the era of proportionate responses' to the US 'is over,' warning of a 'faster, more intense and more painful response.' Separately, reports Sunday revealed a Vance-championed draft HHS rule that would let married couples with a stay-at-home parent draw roughly $9,000 per child annually from the Child Care and Development Fund, a program created to help working parents. The developments capped a week that saw the August jobs report blow past forecasts (+162,000 payrolls) and Trump's approval rating hold near a second-term low, with a multi-aggregator polling average at roughly 38% approve / 58% disapprove.
